name: OahCitizenAnswer
title: OneAquaHealth Citizen Science App answer codes (proposed)
description: The answer codes used by the OneAquaHealth Citizen Science App lookup endpoints (api.enora-oah.eu /api/citizens/water_flows, water_colors, channel_types, channel_forms, bank_types, habitats, fallen_biomass, vegetation_types, stream_assessments), retrieved 2026-10-03, published here so citizen observations can be validated. Some codes (NAT, ART) are shared by several questions; the question gives the context.

concept.definition: Fast: waves, splashing or a quick current (used by: waterFlow)
Slow: moving gently (used by: waterFlow)
Still: barely moving, or only in pools (used by: waterFlow)
Dry: no water in the channel (used by: waterFlow)
Clear: you can see the bottom where it is shallow (used by: waterColor)
Muddy: brown or cloudy (used by: waterColor)
Foamy: foam or bubbles that stay on the surface (used by: waterColor)
Strange colour: green, milky, grey, oily or other (used by: waterColor)
Wide and flat (used by: channelForm)
U shape (used by: channelForm)
V shape: steep sides, narrow bottom (used by: channelForm)
Natural: stones, gravel, sand or mud (used by: bottomChannelType, banksChannelType)
Built: concrete, or stones set in concrete (used by: bottomChannelType, banksChannelType)
Loose stones: stones laid without concrete (used by: banksChannelType)
Sand banks: sand along the edge (used by: habitats)
Sand islands: sand or gravel in the middle (used by: habitats)
Stones: piles of pebbles or rocks (used by: habitats)
Riffles or small falls: water rushing over stones (used by: habitats)
Water plants: plants growing in the water (used by: habitats)
Fallen trees (used by: fallenBiomassTypes)
Fallen branches (used by: fallenBiomassTypes)
Piles of leaves (used by: fallenBiomassTypes)
Grass and herbs (used by: vegetationType)
Shrubs (used by: vegetationType)
Trees (used by: vegetationType)
Good: natural channel, plants on the banks, water looks good, lots of life (used by: overallAssessment)
Moderate: some changes, but still plants on the banks and water looks fine (used by: overallAssessment)
Poor: heavily built-up, few plants or habitats, signs of pollution (used by: overallAssessment)
